<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#493024">
<meta name="description" content="Short poems, stories, and passages. Read in English or Spanish, then open the original beside your translation.">
<title>Katabasis — A reading room</title>

@media(max-width:1050px){.rail{width:215px;padding:32px 20px}main{margin-left:215px;padding:0 28px 50px}.reading{padding:32px}.reading::before{left:32px}.nav{margin-top:45px}.brand{font-size:46px}}

/* One work occupies the reading surface. The next work is drawn only on demand. */
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none}body{background:#eae1d6}.brand{font-size:39px;letter-spacing:-1.5px}.brand small{letter-spacing:2px}.book-bar .brand{font-size:27px}main{height:100dvh;max-width:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0 50px}.topbar{height:86px;flex-shrink:0}.feed-wrap{width:100%;max-width:820px;flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin:24px auto 12px;touch-action:pan-x}#feed{flex:1;min-height:0}.reading{height:100%;margin:0;padding:30px 44px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}.reading h2{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,37px);margin:17px 0 8px;line-height:1.12}.reading::before{left:44px}.preview-wrap{flex:1;min-height:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;margin:24px 0 12px}.read-text{margin:0;font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,24px);line-height:1.65}.preview-wrap.truncated:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:64px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,var(--paper));pointer-events:none}.reading-footer{flex-shrink:0;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:15px;gap:8px}.edition-label{margin:8px 0 0}.scope{margin:0 0 8px;flex-shrink:0}.discovery-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:22px;flex-shrink:0;padding:12px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.discovery-controls button{width:40px;height:38px;padding:0;font-size:21px;background:#fffcf670}.reading.arriving{animation:arrive .25s ease-out}.book-content{touch-action:pan-y}.book-bottom #previous,.book-bottom #next{min-width:80px}.metadata{font-size:12px}.book-title .scope{margin-top:6px}.book-footer-link{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
@keyframes arrive{from{opacity:.5;transform:translateY(var(--entry,15px))}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@media(min-width:1500px){main{margin-left:300px;padding:0 90px}.rail{width:300px}.brand{font-size:43px}}
@media(max-width:1050px){main{padding:0 25px}.brand{font-size:32px}.reading{padding:25px 30px}.reading::before{left:30px}}

@media(max-height:610px){.topbar{height:43px}.feed-wrap{margin-top:10px}.reading{padding-top:16px;padding-bottom:12px}.reading h2{font-size:25px;margin:10px 0 5px}.preview-wrap{margin:12px 0 6px}.edition-label,.scope{display:none}.reading-footer{padding-top:8px}.discovery-controls{padding-top:6px}.rail{padding-top:22px}.nav{margin-top:28px}}

@font-face{font-family:KatabasisEthiopic;src:url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format('truetype');font-display:swap} .parallel-cell[lang=gez]{font-family:KatabasisEthiopic,Nyala,serif} .source-edition{margin-top:12px!important;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
/* Collection atlas and full-screen painting interludes. */
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.catalog-view{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:30px 2px 45px;scroll-behavior:smooth;touch-action:pan-y}
.catalog-inner{max-width:1160px;margin:auto}
.catalog-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:22px;margin:0 0 25px}
.catalog-heading .tiny-title{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--muted)}
.catalog-heading h2{font:normal clamp(28px,3vw,40px)/1.15 var(--serif);margin:0}
.catalog-heading p:last-child{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);max-width:53ch}
.catalog-stats{display:flex;gap:25px;flex-shrink:0}
.catalog-stats div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.catalog-stats strong{font:normal 30px/1.2 var(--serif);color:var(--ink)}
.atlas{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}
.atlas-top{padding:18px 22px 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}
.atlas-top p{margin:0;font:normal 20px var(--serif)}
.map-views{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.map-views button{font-size:12px;border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:3px;color:var(--muted)}
.map-views button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#eee1d1;border-color:#ddc4a9;color:var(--ink)}
.world-map{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:900/370;max-height:420px;background:#f8f3eb}
.country{fill:#e6dbce;stroke:var(--paper);stroke-width:.7;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;transition:fill .15s}
.country.available{cursor:pointer;fill:var(--country-color)}
.country.available:hover,.country.available:focus{fill:#b8773f;stroke:#493024;stroke-width:1.5;outline:none}
.country.selected{fill:#b8773f;stroke:#3f271c;stroke-width:2}
.map-caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:12px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.map-caption p{margin:0}
.map-key{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.map-key i{width:10px;height:10px;display:inline-block;background:var(--swatch);border-radius:2px;margin-right:4px}
.catalog-bottom{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(200px,1fr) minmax(0,1.5fr);gap:28px;margin-top:27px;align-items:start}
.country-index h3,.catalog-results h3{font:normal 26px var(--serif);margin:0 0 12px}
.country-index-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.country-index-head button{font-size:12px;border:0;background:transparent;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;padding:8px 0}
.region-buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px}
.region-button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;text-align:left;gap:10px;min-width:0;border:1px solid #d5c3b0;border-radius:4px;padding:9px 10px;background:#f6eee4;font-size:13px}
.region-button span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.region-button b{font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;min-width:22px;text-align:center;border-radius:30px;background:#e6d5c1;color:#614127;padding:1px 5px}
.region-button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.region-button:hover{border-color:#916847}
.ancient-index{margin-top:24px}
.ancient-index h4{font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted)}
.ancient-index .region-buttons{grid-template-columns:1fr}
.geography-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:17px 0 0;line-height:1.6}
.catalog-results{background:var(--paper);padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px}
.catalog-results h3{margin-bottom:4px}
.result-summary{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 22px}
.author-group+.author-group{margin-top:23px;padding-top:19px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.author-group h4{font:normal 19px var(--serif);margin:0 0 3px}
.author-place{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 10px}
.catalog-work{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;background:#f5eee5;border:1px solid transparent;padding:12px;border-radius:3px;margin-top:6px}
.catalog-work:hover{background:#efe0ce;border-color:#d7b794}
.catalog-work strong{font-size:14px;font-weight:normal;display:block}

.ancient-marker{cursor:pointer;outline:none}.ancient-marker circle{fill:#f9eedc;stroke:#69452c;stroke-width:1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}.ancient-marker text{font:5.6px var(--sans);fill:#4c301e;pointer-events:none}.ancient-marker:hover circle,.ancient-marker:focus circle,.ancient-marker.selected circle{fill:#d4b486;stroke:#392316;stroke-width:2}.ancient-map-key{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:9px 0 0}

.packages-view{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;touch-action:pan-y;padding:30px 2px 45px}
.packages-inner{max-width:1080px;margin:auto}

.packages-heading p{margin:10px 0 23px;font-size:16px;color:var(--muted)}

.text-button{background:none;border:0;color:inherit;padding:0;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;text-align:left}

.package-list{display:grid;gap:21px}.package-card{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}.package-card.enabled{border-color:#a27b50}
.package-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:155px minmax(0,1fr) 84px;gap:24px;padding:24px;align-items:center}.package-cover{width:155px;height:160px;object-fit:contain;background:#e9dfd1;border-radius:2px}
.package-copy h3{font:normal 27px/1.17 var(--serif);margin:0 0 10px}.package-copy>p{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 16px;line-height:1.6}.package-counts{display:flex;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:14px}
.package-toggle{background:none;border:0;padding:10px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14px;min-height:76px}.switch-track{display:block;width:46px;height:26px;border-radius:30px;background:#d2c5b5;border:1px solid #af9981;padding:3px;transition:background .15s}.switch-track>span{display:block;width:18px;height:18px;background:#fffaf1;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #49302433;border-radius:50%;transition:transform .15s}.package-toggle[aria-checked=true] .switch-track{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}.package-toggle[aria-checked=true] .switch-track>span{transform:translateX(19px);background:var(--gold)}
.package-details{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.package-details summary{font-size:14px;padding:12px 24px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted)}.package-detail-body{padding:0 24px 24px}.package-editor-note{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 21px}
.package-reading-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px 24px}.package-reading-list>div{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px}.package-type{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:var(--muted)}.package-reading-list h4{font:normal 21px/1.25 var(--serif);margin:6px 0}.package-reading-list p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:3px 0}
.package-art-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:26px}.package-art-list figure{margin:0;min-width:0}.package-art-list img{width:100%;height:155px;object-fit:contain;background:#ede4d9;display:block}.package-art-list figcaption{padding-top:9px;font-size:12px}.package-art-list figcaption strong{display:block;font-weight:normal;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4}.package-art-list figcaption span,.package-art-list figcaption>a{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.packages-footnote{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.7;margin:22px 0 0;max-width:85ch}
.art-context{max-width:80ch;margin:8px auto!important;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.package-main{grid-template-columns:115px minmax(0,1fr) 62px;gap:18px;padding:21px}.package-cover{width:115px;height:150px}.package-copy h3{font-size:25px}.package-counts{gap:10px;font-size:13px}}
@media(max-width:730px){.packages-view{padding-top:22px}.packages-heading h2{font-size:31px}.package-main{grid-template-columns:86px minmax(0,1fr) 48px;gap:13px;padding:18px 15px;align-items:start}.package-cover{width:86px;height:116px}.package-copy h3{font-size:22px}.package-copy>p{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:12px}.package-toggle{font-size:12px;padding-top:0}.package-counts{font-size:12px;gap:5px 12px}.package-selection{gap:8px;font-size:14px}.package-selection .text-button{margin-left:0;width:100%;margin-top:4px}.base-package{padding:15px}.base-package h3{font-size:20px}.base-included{font-size:12px;white-space:normal;max-width:80px;text-align:right}.base-package h3 span{display:inline-block;margin:5px 0 0 3px}.package-details summary{padding:12px 15px}.package-detail-body{padding:0 15px 20px}.package-reading-list{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:13px}.package-art-list{gap:12px;grid-template-columns:1fr}.package-art-list figure{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr;gap:12px}.package-art-list img{height:110px}.package-art-list figcaption{padding-top:0}}
@media(max-width:400px){.package-main{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 52px}.package-cover{display:none}.package-copy h3{font-size:24px}.rail .brand{font-size:23px}.nav button{padding:5px}.mobile-language button{padding:5px}}

/* A quiet, text-only disclosure for the always-included anthology. */
.base-package{display:block}.base-package-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.base-readings{margin-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #b8a38a}.base-readings summary{padding:12px 0 2px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink)}.base-readings ul{list-style:none;margin:12px 0 0;padding:0;max-width:760px}.base-readings li{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px 18px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:9px 0;border-top:1px solid #c7b59e}.base-readings li:first-child{border-top:0}.base-readings .text-button{font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none}.base-readings .text-button:hover{text-decoration:underline}.base-readings li>span{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}

/* Preserve the sung verse inside otherwise spoken theatre scenes. */
.parallel.theatre .segment,.read-text.theatre .verse{white-space:pre-line}

.journey-feed-link{border:0;background:none;padding:0;color:#785030;font:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;text-align:left}
.journey-panel,.journey-end{padding:22px 36px;background:#f1e8db;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.journey-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;font:19px/1.4 var(--serif)}
.journey-heading span{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--muted);font:13px/1.8 var(--sans)}
.journey-outline{margin:10px 0 16px;font-size:13px;color:#705946}
.journey-outline summary{cursor:pointer}
.journey-outline p{max-width:80ch}.journey-outline ol{padding-left:24px}.journey-outline li{margin:8px 0}.journey-outline [aria-current=step]{font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline}.journey-outline small{color:var(--muted)}
.journey-editorial{font:11px/1.5 var(--sans);letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#805a3b;margin:14px 0 6px}
.journey-bridge,.journey-end>p:not(.journey-editorial):not(.journey-finished){font:17px/1.65 var(--serif);max-width:90ch;margin:0}
.journey-next{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.journey-next button{max-width:100%;font-size:13px;text-align:left;white-space:normal}
.journey-finished{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:16px 0 0}
.journey-collection{margin:38px 0 22px}.journey-collection>h3{font:28px var(--serif);margin:0 0 12px}.journey-collection>p{max-width:78ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.journey-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:20px}.journey-cards article{padding:22px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px}.journey-cards h4{font:22px/1.3 var(--serif);margin:10px 0}.journey-cards p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}.journey-cards .text-button{font-size:13px;text-align:left}
@media(max-width:1000px){.journey-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:730px){.journey-panel,.journey-end{padding:18px}.journey-heading{font-size:18px}.journey-bridge{font-size:16px}.journey-next{flex-direction:column}.journey-next button{width:100%}.journey-cards article{padding:18px}}

.favorite-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #b59b80;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font-size:14px;flex-shrink:0;min-height:40px}
.favorite-button:hover{background:#e7d6c2}.favorite-button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#eee0ca;border-color:#9a713f}.favorite-button[aria-pressed=true] .icon{fill:#be945c;stroke:#68462f}
.book-title .favorite-button{margin-top:14px}.painting-caption .favorite-button{margin-top:10px}.art-detail-caption .favorite-button{display:flex;margin-top:16px;background:#f4e8d7;color:#4b3629}
.art-rights{font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;color:#d7c6b1}.art-rights a{color:inherit}
.saved-count{margin-left:auto;border:1px solid #9b7a56;border-radius:12px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:12px;font-weight:normal}
.saved-count[hidden],.favorites-view[hidden]{display:none!important}
.favorites-view{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;touch-action:pan-y;padding:30px 2px 45px}
.favorites-inner{max-width:900px;margin:auto}.favorites-heading .tiny-title{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 8px}.favorites-heading h2{font:normal clamp(30px,3vw,40px)/1.2 var(--serif);margin:0}.favorites-heading>p:last-child{color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 22px}
.favorites-total{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}.favorites-list{display:grid;gap:14px}.saved-item{display:flex;align-items:start;gap:20px;padding:22px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:4px}.saved-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}.saved-copy h3{font:normal 26px/1.25 var(--serif);margin:5px 0 8px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.saved-copy p{margin:0;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}.saved-copy .saved-meta{font-size:13px}.saved-copy .saved-package{margin-top:12px}.saved-open{margin-top:14px;font-size:14px;text-align:left}.saved-art{width:108px;height:135px;object-fit:contain;background:#e8ddce;flex-shrink:0}.favorites-note{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:28px}.favorites-empty{border:1px solid var(--line);padding:35px;background:var(--paper);margin-top:28px}.favorites-empty p:first-child{font:normal 27px var(--serif)}.favorites-empty .book-btn{margin-top:22px}
@media(min-width:731px){.rail{overflow-y:auto}.nav{margin-top:42px;gap:6px}}
@media(max-width:730px){.saved-count{display:none}.favorites-view{padding-top:22px}.saved-item{gap:12px;padding:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}.saved-copy h3{font-size:23px}.saved-art{width:78px;height:100px}.saved-item>.favorite-button{margin-left:auto}.favorites-empty{padding:24px}.reading-footer .source-link{margin-left:auto}.nav button{padding:6px}.rail{gap:5px}.rail .brand{flex-shrink:0}.mobile-language{flex-shrink:0}}
@media(max-width:400px){.rail{padding:10px}.rail .brand{font-size:23px}.nav button{padding:4px}.nav button svg{width:18px;height:18px}.mobile-language button{padding:4px}.reading-footer .source-link{width:100%;margin-top:2px}.saved-item>.favorite-button{font-size:14px}.saved-art{width:65px;height:88px}}

/* Writing workshop */
.workshop-view{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:30px 2px 50px}
.workshop-inner{max-width:1120px;margin:auto}
.workshop-heading{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:24px}
.workshop-heading h2{font:normal 38px/1.15 var(--serif);margin:0}
.workshop-heading p{margin:9px 0 0;max-width:66ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.workshop-local{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);max-width:29ch;text-align:right}
.practice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:0 0 28px}
.practice-card{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);padding:15px;text-align:left;min-height:108px;border-radius:4px}
.practice-card strong{display:block;font:normal 18px var(--serif);margin-bottom:6px}.practice-card span{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
.practice-card.active{border-color:#9b7349;background:#fff9ef}.practice-card[disabled]{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
.meter-workspace{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(280px,.82fr) minmax(390px,1.18fr);gap:24px;align-items:start}
.meter-panel,.poem-sheet{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px}
.meter-panel{padding:22px;position:sticky;top:0}
.meter-panel h3{font:normal 27px var(--serif);margin:0 0 5px}.meter-panel>p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 18px}
.form-picker{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-bottom:15px}
.form-picker button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fbf5eb;padding:9px 10px;text-align:left;border-radius:3px;font-size:13px}
.form-picker button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff7eb;border-color:var(--ink)}
.workshop-textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-height:380px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid #cdbda9;background:#fffdfa;color:var(--ink);padding:16px;font:18px/1.75 var(--serif);border-radius:3px;outline:none}
.workshop-textarea:focus{border-color:#8d6742;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #a6753222}
.draft-status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.poem-sheet{padding:27px 24px 31px;min-height:540px}
.poem-sheet-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.poem-sheet-head h3{font:normal 28px var(--serif);margin:0 0 4px}.poem-sheet-head p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}
.rhyme-key{font:12px/1.5 var(--sans);letter-spacing:1px;color:#715943;text-align:right;white-space:pre-line}
.meter-stanza{padding-top:18px}.meter-stanza+.meter-stanza{margin-top:7px;border-top:1px solid #e8ddd0}
.meter-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px minmax(0,1fr) 63px;gap:10px;align-items:start;min-height:56px;padding:5px 0}
.meter-number{font:11px var(--sans);color:#9a8876;padding-top:5px;text-align:right}
.meter-line{min-width:0}.meter-line-text{font:18px/1.35 var(--serif);min-height:25px;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.meter-line-text.empty{color:#b9a997;font-style:italic}
.meter-slots{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px;min-height:8px}
.meter-slot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #bba993;background:transparent}
.meter-slot.filled{background:#705039;border-color:#705039}.meter-slot.overflow{background:#9b3e32;border-color:#9b3e32}
.meter-count{font:12px var(--sans);text-align:right;padding-top:4px;color:var(--muted)}.meter-count.good{color:#466044}.meter-count.over{color:#8b3329}
.meter-detail{font:11px/1.4 var(--sans);color:#9b8977;margin-top:5px}
.meter-adjust{display:inline-flex;gap:3px;margin-left:6px}.meter-adjust button{border:0;background:none;color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;padding:0 2px;font-size:11px}
.workshop-note{margin:19px 0 0;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
@media(max-width:1050px){.practice-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.meter-workspace{grid-template-columns:1fr}.meter-panel{position:static}.workshop-textarea{min-height:260px}}
@media(max-width:730px){.workshop-view{padding-top:22px}.workshop-heading{display:block}.workshop-heading h2{font-size:31px}.workshop-local{text-align:left;margin-top:9px}.practice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.meter-panel,.poem-sheet{padding:18px}.form-picker{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.meter-row{grid-template-columns:22px minmax(0,1fr) 54px;gap:7px}.meter-line-text{font-size:16px}.meter-slot{width:7px;height:7px}}

</style>

<aside class="rail" aria-label="Reading room navigation">

<nav class="nav">

Its speaker contradicts and corrects himself; the author’s introductory footnote is outside this selection. The collegiate assessor was a rank in the Russian civil service.","segments":[[{"original":"Я человек больной… Я злой человек. Непривлекательный я человек. Я думаю, что у меня болит печень. Впрочем, я ни шиша не смыслю в моей болезни и не знаю наверно, что у меня болит. Я не лечусь и никогда не лечился, хотя медицину и докторов уважаю. К тому же я еще и суеверен до крайности; ну, хоть настолько, чтоб уважать медицину. (Я достаточно образован, чтоб не быть суеверным, но я суеверен). Нет-с, я не хочу лечиться со злости. Вот этого, наверно, не изволите понимать. Ну-с, а я понимаю. Я, разумеется, не сумею вам объяснить, кому именно я насолю в этом случае моей злостью; я отлично хорошо знаю, что и докторам я никак не смогу «нагадить» тем, что у них не лечусь; я лучше всякого знаю, что всем этим я единственно только себе поврежу и никому больше. Но все-таки, если я не лечусь, так это со злости. Печенка болит, так вот пускай же ее еще крепче болит!","en":"I am a sick man… I am a spiteful man. An unattractive man. I think my liver hurts. Still, I understand not a damn thing about my illness, and do not know for certain what hurts. I seek no treatment and never have, though I respect medicine and doctors. Besides, I am superstitious to an extreme—well, at least enough to respect medicine. (I am educated enough not to be superstitious, but I am superstitious.) No, sir, I refuse treatment out of spite. That, I suppose, you do not care to understand. Well, I understand it. Of course I shall not be able to explain whom, exactly, I am hurting with my spite in this case; I know perfectly well that I cannot “do anything nasty” to the doctors by refusing their treatment; I know better than anyone that in all this I shall harm only myself and no one else. But all the same, if I refuse treatment, it is out of spite. My liver hurts? Then let it hurt still worse!","es":"Soy un hombre enfermo… Soy un hombre rencoroso. Soy un hombre poco atractivo. Creo que me duele el hígado. Aunque, en realidad, no entiendo un carajo de mi enfermedad y no sé con certeza qué me duele. No me trato ni me he tratado nunca, aunque respeto la medicina y a los médicos. Además, soy supersticioso hasta el extremo; bueno, al menos lo bastante para respetar la medicina. (Tengo suficiente educación para no ser supersticioso, pero lo soy.) No, señor, no quiero tratarme por puro despecho. Eso seguramente no tendrán a bien entenderlo. Pues yo sí lo entiendo. Naturalmente, no sabré explicarles a quién perjudico exactamente con mi despecho en este caso; sé perfectamente que tampoco podré «fastidiar» a los médicos por no acudir a ellos; sé mejor que nadie que con todo esto solo me haré daño a mí mismo y a nadie más. Pero, aun así, si no me trato es por despecho. ¿Me duele el hígado? ¡Pues que me duela todavía más!"}],[{"original":"Я уже давно так живу — лет двадцать. Теперь мне сорок. Я прежде служил, а теперь не служу. Я был злой чиновник. Я был груб и находил в этом удовольствие. Ведь я взяток не брал, стало быть, должен же был себя хоть этим вознаградить. (Плохая острота; но я ее не вычеркну. Я ее написал, думая, что выйдет очень остро; а теперь, как увидел сам, что хотел только гнусно пофорсить, — нарочно не вычеркну!) Когда к столу, у которого я сидел, подходили, бывало, просители за справками, — я зубами на них скрежетал и чувствовал неумолимое наслаждение, когда удавалось кого-нибудь огорчить. Почти всегда удавалось. Большею частию все был народ робкий: известно — просители. Но из фертов я особенно терпеть не мог одного офицера. Он никак не хотел покориться и омерзительно гремел саблей. У меня с ним полтора года за эту саблю война была. Я наконец одолел. Он перестал греметь. Впрочем, это случилось еще в моей молодости. Но знаете ли, господа, в чем состоял главный пункт моей злости? Да в том-то и состояла вся штука, в том-то и заключалась наибольшая гадость, что я поминутно, даже в минуту самой сильнейшей желчи, постыдно сознавал в себе, что я не только не злой, но даже и не озлобленный человек, что я только воробьев пугаю напрасно и себя этим тешу. У меня пена у рта, а принесите мне какую-нибудь куколку, дайте мне чайку с сахарцем, я, пожалуй, и успокоюсь. Даже душой умилюсь, хоть уж, наверно, потом буду вам на себя скрежетать зубами и от стыда несколько месяцев страдать бессонницей. Таков уж мой обычай.","en":"I have lived like this a long time—twenty years. Now I am forty. I used to be in government service; now I am not. I was a spiteful official. I was rude and took pleasure in it. After all, I took no bribes, so I had to reward myself with something. (A poor joke; but I shall not cross it out. I wrote it thinking it would be very witty; now that I see I only wanted to show off in a nasty way, I shall deliberately leave it in!) When petitioners came to the desk where I sat to ask for information, I used to grind my teeth at them and feel a relentless delight whenever I succeeded in upsetting someone. I almost always succeeded. For the most part they were timid people: petitioners, naturally. But among the swaggering fellows I especially could not bear one officer. He would not submit, and made a disgusting clatter with his sabre. I fought a war with him for a year and a half over that sabre. At last I won. He stopped clattering. This happened in my younger days, though. But do you know, gentlemen, the chief point of my spite? The whole trick, the nastiest thing of all, was that every moment, even in the moment of my strongest bitterness, I was shamefully aware that I was not merely not spiteful, but not even embittered: I was only frightening sparrows for nothing and amusing myself with it. I foam at the mouth, but bring me some little doll, give me some tea with sugar, and I may well calm down. I may even feel tender in my soul, though afterwards I shall certainly grind my teeth at myself in your presence and lie awake from shame for several months. That is my way.","es":"Hace mucho que vivo así: unos veinte años. Ahora tengo cuarenta. Antes era funcionario, ahora ya no. Era un funcionario rencoroso. Era grosero y encontraba placer en ello. Como no aceptaba sobornos, tenía que recompensarme al menos con eso. (Una mala ocurrencia; pero no la tacharé. La escribí pensando que resultaría muy ingeniosa; ahora que yo mismo veo que solo quería presumir de un modo despreciable, ¡no la tacharé a propósito!) Cuando los solicitantes se acercaban a la mesa donde yo estaba sentado para pedir información, les rechinaba los dientes y sentía un placer implacable cuando lograba disgustar a alguien. Casi siempre lo lograba. En su mayoría eran gente tímida: solicitantes, ya se sabe. Pero entre los presumidos había un oficial al que no podía soportar en particular. No quería someterse y hacía sonar su sable de manera repugnante. Estuve en guerra con él durante año y medio por aquel sable. Al fin lo vencí. Dejó de hacerlo sonar. Eso, por cierto, ocurrió todavía en mi juventud. Pero ¿saben, señores, en qué consistía lo principal de mi rencor? Ahí estaba precisamente toda la cuestión, ahí residía la mayor bajeza: a cada instante, incluso en el momento de mi bilis más intensa, advertía con vergüenza que no solo no era rencoroso, sino que ni siquiera estaba amargado; que únicamente asustaba gorriones sin motivo y me divertía con ello. Me sale espuma por la boca, pero tráiganme un muñequito, denme un té con azúcar, y quizá me calme. Hasta se me enternecerá el alma, aunque después, seguramente, rechinaré los dientes contra mí mismo ante ustedes y sufriré de insomnio por vergüenza durante varios meses. Así son mis costumbres."}],[{"original":"Это я наврал про себя давеча, что я был злой чиновник. Со злости наврал. Я просто баловством занимался и с просителями и с офицером, а в сущности никогда не мог сделаться злым. Я поминутно сознавал в себе много-премного самых противоположных тому элементов. Я чувствовал, что они так и кишат во мне, эти противоположные элементы. Я знал, что они всю жизнь во мне кишели и из меня вон наружу просились, но я их не пускал, не пускал, нарочно не пускал наружу. Они мучили меня до стыда; до конвульсий меня доводили и — надоели мне наконец, как надоели! Уж не кажется ли вам, господа, что я теперь в чем-то перед вами раскаиваюсь, что я в чем-то у вас прощенья прошу?.. Я уверен, что вам это кажется… А впрочем, уверяю вас, что мне все равно, если и кажется…","en":"I lied about myself just now when I said I was a spiteful official. I lied out of spite. I was merely fooling about with the petitioners and the officer; in essence I could never become spiteful. Every moment I was aware of a great many elements in myself that were utterly opposed to that. I felt those opposing elements swarming inside me. I knew that they had swarmed there all my life and were begging to come out, but I would not let them, would not let them, deliberately would not let them out. They tormented me to the point of shame; they drove me into convulsions and finally—how tired I was of them! Does it seem to you, gentlemen, that I am now repenting of something before you, asking your forgiveness for something?.. I am sure it seems so… But I assure you that I do not care if it does…","es":"Hace un momento mentí sobre mí mismo al decir que era un funcionario rencoroso. Mentí por despecho. Simplemente hacía tonterías con los solicitantes y con el oficial; en el fondo, nunca pude llegar a ser rencoroso. A cada instante advertía en mí muchísimos elementos del todo contrarios. Sentía cómo bullían dentro de mí esos elementos contrarios. Sabía que habían bullido en mí toda la vida y que pedían salir, pero no los dejaba, no los dejaba, no los dejaba salir a propósito. Me atormentaban hasta la vergüenza, me llevaban a las convulsiones y al final me hartaron: ¡cuánto me hartaron! ¿No les parece, señores, que ahora me arrepiento de algo ante ustedes, que les pido perdón por algo?.. Estoy seguro de que les parece… Aunque, por otra parte, les aseguro que me da igual que así sea…"}],[{"original":"Я не только злым, но даже и ничем не сумел сделаться: ни злым, ни добрым, ни подлецом, ни честным, ни героем, ни насекомым. Теперь же доживаю в своем углу, дразня себя злобным и ни к чему не служащим утешением, что умный человек и не может серьезно чем-нибудь сделаться, а делается чем-нибудь только дурак. Да-с, умный человек девятнадцатого столетия должен и нравственно обязан быть существом по преимуществу бесхарактерным; человек же с характером, деятель, — существом по преимуществу ограниченным. Это сорокалетнее мое убеждение. Мне теперь сорок лет, а ведь сорок лет — это вся жизнь; ведь это самая глубокая старость. Дальше сорока лет жить неприлично, пошло, безнравственно! Кто живет дольше сорока лет, — отвечайте искренно, честно? Я вам скажу, кто живет: дураки и негодяи живут. Я всем старцам это в глаза скажу, всем этим почтенным старцам, всем этим сребровласым и благоухающим старцам! Всему свету в глаза скажу! Я имею право так говорить, потому что сам до шестидесяти лет доживу. До семидесяти лет проживу! До восьмидесяти лет проживу!.. Постойте! Дайте дух перевести…","en":"I failed to become not only spiteful but anything at all: neither spiteful nor good, neither a scoundrel nor an honest man, neither a hero nor an insect. Now I live out my days in my corner, teasing myself with the spiteful and useless consolation that an intelligent man cannot seriously become anything, and only a fool becomes something. Yes, sir, an intelligent man of the nineteenth century must be, is morally bound to be, above all a creature without character; a man of character, a man of action, must above all be limited. That is my conviction at forty. I am forty now, and forty years is a whole life; it is the deepest old age. To live beyond forty is indecent, vulgar, immoral! Who lives past forty? Answer honestly, sincerely. I shall tell you who: fools and scoundrels. I shall say it to the face of every old man, all those venerable old men, all those silver-haired and fragrant old men! I shall say it to the whole world’s face! I have a right to speak like that, because I myself shall live to sixty. I shall live to seventy! I shall live to eighty!.. Wait! Let me catch my breath…","es":"No conseguí volverme rencoroso, ni siquiera conseguí volverme nada: ni malo ni bueno, ni canalla ni honrado, ni héroe ni insecto. Ahora termino mis días en mi rincón, provocándome con el consuelo malicioso e inútil de que un hombre inteligente no puede convertirse seriamente en nada y que solo un necio se convierte en algo. Sí, señor, un hombre inteligente del siglo diecinueve debe, tiene la obligación moral de ser, ante todo, un ser sin carácter; el hombre de carácter, el hombre de acción, debe ser, ante todo, limitado. Esta es mi convicción a los cuarenta años. Ahora tengo cuarenta, y cuarenta años son toda una vida; son la vejez más profunda. ¡Vivir más de cuarenta años es indecente, vulgar e inmoral! ¿Quién vive más de cuarenta? Respondan con sinceridad, honradamente. Les diré quién: viven los necios y los canallas. ¡Se lo diré a la cara a todos los ancianos, a todos esos ancianos venerables, a todos esos ancianos de cabellos de plata y buen olor! ¡Se lo diré a la cara al mundo entero! Tengo derecho a hablar así porque yo mismo viviré hasta los sesenta. ¡Viviré hasta los setenta! ¡Viviré hasta los ochenta!.. ¡Esperen! Déjenme tomar aliento…"}],[{"original":"Наверно, вы думаете, господа, что я вас смешить хочу? Ошиблись и в этом. Я вовсе не такой развеселый человек, как вам кажется или как вам, может быть, кажется; впрочем, если вы, раздраженные всей этой болтовней (а я уже чувствую, что вы раздражены), вздумаете спросить меня: кто ж я таков именно? — то я вам отвечу: я один коллежский асессор. Я служил, чтоб было что-нибудь есть (но единственно для этого), и когда прошлого года один из отдаленных моих родственников оставил мне шесть тысяч рублей по духовному завещанию, я тотчас же вышел в отставку и поселился у себя в углу. Я и прежде жил в этом углу, но теперь я поселился в этом углу. Комната моя дрянная, скверная, на краю города. Служанка моя — деревенская баба, старая, злая от глупости, и от нее к тому же всегда скверно пахнет. Мне говорят, что климат петербургский мне становится вреден и что с моими ничтожными средствами очень дорого в Петербурге жить. Я все это знаю, лучше всех этих опытных и премудрых советчиков и покивателей знаю. Но я остаюсь в Петербурге; я не выеду из Петербурга! Я потому не выеду… Эх! да ведь это совершенно все равно — выеду я иль не выеду.","en":"Surely you think, gentlemen, that I want to make you laugh? Wrong again. I am not at all the cheerful fellow you think I am, or perhaps think I am. Still, if, irritated by all this chatter—and I already feel that you are irritated—you decide to ask me exactly who I am, I shall answer: I am a collegiate assessor. I worked so that I should have something to eat, and for that reason alone; and when last year a distant relative left me six thousand roubles in his will, I retired at once and settled into my corner. I had lived in that corner before, but now I settled into it. My room is shabby, wretched, on the edge of the city. My servant is a countrywoman, old, spiteful out of stupidity, and besides she always smells bad. They tell me that the Petersburg climate is becoming harmful to me and that, with my paltry means, living in Petersburg is very expensive. I know all this, know it better than all those experienced and wise advisers and head-shakers. But I am staying in Petersburg; I shall not leave Petersburg! I shall not leave because… Ah! It makes absolutely no difference whether I leave or not.","es":"¿Seguramente piensan, señores, que quiero hacerles reír? También en eso se equivocan. No soy en absoluto tan alegre como les parece, o como quizá les parece; aunque si, irritados por toda esta charla —y ya siento que están irritados—, se les ocurre preguntarme quién soy exactamente, les responderé: soy un asesor colegiado. Trabajaba para tener algo que comer, y únicamente por eso; y cuando el año pasado un pariente lejano me dejó seis mil rublos en su testamento, me retiré enseguida y me instalé en mi rincón. Ya vivía antes en ese rincón, pero ahora me instalé en él. Mi habitación es miserable, asquerosa, en las afueras de la ciudad. Mi criada es una campesina vieja, mala por estupidez, y además siempre huele mal. Me dicen que el clima de Petersburgo está empezando a perjudicarme y que, con mis medios insignificantes, resulta muy caro vivir en Petersburgo. Todo eso lo sé, lo sé mejor que todos esos consejeros experimentados y sapientísimos que menean la cabeza. Pero me quedo en Petersburgo; ¡no me iré de Petersburgo! No me iré porque… ¡Bah! Da exactamente lo mismo que me vaya o que no me vaya."}],[{"original":"А впрочем: о чем может говорить порядочный человек с наибольшим удовольствием?","en":"Still: what does a decent man most enjoy talking about?","es":"Pero, en fin: ¿de qué puede hablar un hombre decente con mayor placer?"}],[{"original":"Ответ: о себе.","en":"Answer: himself.","es":"Respuesta: de sí mismo."}],[{"original":"Ну так и я буду говорить о себе.","en":"Well, then I too shall talk about myself.","es":"Pues entonces yo también hablaré de mí mismo."}]],"eligibility":"Born in a historically majority-Christian country or society.","title_es":"Un comienzo rencoroso","scope_es":"Apuntes del subsuelo · parte I, capítulo 1 completo","note_es":"El primer capítulo completo de la parte I, no la parte I entera. contemplation of these pictures, and the perusal of a small volume which had been found upon the pillow, and which purported to criticise and describe them.","es":" Deseaba todo esto para entregarme, si no al sueño, al menos alternativamente a contemplar aquellas pinturas y a leer un pequeño volumen encontrado sobre la almohada, que al parecer las describía y comentaba."}],[{"original":"Long, long I read—and devoutly, devotedly I gazed.","en":"Long, long I read—and devoutly, devotedly I gazed.","es":"Largo, largo rato leí, y con devoción, con entrega, miré."},{"original":" Rapidly and gloriously the hours flew by and the deep midnight came.","en":" Rapidly and gloriously the hours flew by and the deep midnight came.","es":" Las horas volaron rápidas y gloriosas, y llegó la medianoche profunda."},{"original":" The position of the candelabrum displeased me, and outreaching my hand with difficulty, rather than disturb my slumbering valet, I placed it so as to throw its rays more fully upon the book.","en":" The position of the candelabrum displeased me, and outreaching my hand with difficulty, rather than disturb my slumbering valet, I placed it so as to throw its rays more fully upon the book.","es":" La posición del candelabro me desagradaba y, extendiendo con dificultad la mano antes que molestar a mi criado dormido, lo coloqué de modo que su luz cayera más plenamente sobre el libro."}],[{"original":"But the action produced an effect altogether unanticipated.","en":"But the action produced an effect altogether unanticipated.","es":"Pero aquella acción produjo un efecto completamente inesperado."},{"original":" The rays of the numerous candles (for there were many) now fell within a niche of the room which had hitherto been thrown into deep shade by one of the bed-posts.","en":" The rays of the numerous candles (for there were many) now fell within a niche of the room which had hitherto been thrown into deep shade by one of the bed-posts.","es":" Los rayos de las numerosas velas —pues eran muchas— iluminaron entonces un nicho del cuarto que hasta ese momento había permanecido en la profunda sombra de uno de los postes de la cama."},{"original":" I thus saw in vivid light a picture all unnoticed before.","en":" I thus saw in vivid light a picture all unnoticed before.","es":" Así vi, bajo una luz viva, una pintura que antes no había advertido."},{"original":" It was the portrait of a young girl just ripening into womanhood.","en":" It was the portrait of a young girl just ripening into womanhood.","es":" Era el retrato de una muchacha que apenas empezaba a hacerse mujer."},{"original":" I glanced at the painting hurriedly, and then closed my eyes.","en":" I glanced at the painting hurriedly, and then closed my eyes.","es":" Miré apresuradamente la pintura y luego cerré los ojos."},{"original":" Why I did this was not at first apparent even to my own perception.","en":" Why I did this was not at first apparent even to my own perception.","es":" Al principio ni yo mismo comprendí por qué lo había hecho."},{"original":" But while my lids remained thus shut, I ran over in my mind my reason for so shutting them.","en":" But while my lids remained thus shut, I ran over in my mind my reason for so shutting them.","es":" Pero mientras mantenía cerrados los párpados repasé mentalmente la razón de haberlos cerrado."},{"original":" It was an impulsive movement to gain time for thought—to make sure that my vision had not deceived me—to calm and subdue my fancy for a more sober and more certain gaze.","en":" It was an impulsive movement to gain time for thought—to make sure that my vision had not deceived me—to calm and subdue my fancy for a more sober and more certain gaze.","es":" Había sido un movimiento impulsivo para ganar tiempo para pensar, para asegurarme de que la vista no me había engañado, para calmar y dominar mi imaginación antes de mirar con mayor serenidad y certeza."},{"original":" In a very few moments I again looked fixedly at the painting.","en":" In a very few moments I again looked fixedly at the painting.","es":" En muy pocos instantes volví a fijar los ojos en la pintura."}],[{"original":"That I now saw aright I could not and would not doubt; for the first flashing of the candles upon that canvas had seemed to dissipate the dreamy stupor which was stealing over my senses, and to startle me at once into waking life.","en":"That I now saw aright I could not and would not doubt; for the first flashing of the candles upon that canvas had seemed to dissipate the dreamy stupor which was stealing over my senses, and to startle me at once into waking life.","es":"No podía ni quería dudar de que ahora veía correctamente, pues el primer resplandor de las velas sobre aquel lienzo había parecido disipar el sopor soñador que se apoderaba de mis sentidos y despertarme de golpe a la vida consciente."}],[{"original":"The portrait, I have already said, was that of a young girl.","en":"The portrait, I have already said, was that of a young girl.","es":"El retrato, como ya he dicho, era el de una muchacha."},{"original":" It was a mere head and shoulders, done in what is technically termed a vignette manner; much in the style of the favorite heads of Sully.","en":" It was a mere head and shoulders, done in what is technically termed a vignette manner; much in the style of the favorite heads of Sully.","es":" Solo mostraba la cabeza y los hombros, ejecutados en lo que técnicamente se llama estilo de viñeta, muy a la manera de las cabezas favoritas de Sully."},{"original":" The arms, the bosom, and even the ends of the radiant hair melted imperceptibly into the vague yet deep shadow which formed the back-ground of the whole.","en":" The arms, the bosom, and even the ends of the radiant hair melted imperceptibly into the vague yet deep shadow which formed the back-ground of the whole.","es":" Los brazos, el pecho e incluso las puntas del cabello radiante se desvanecían imperceptiblemente en la sombra vaga pero profunda que formaba el fondo del conjunto."},{"original":" The frame was oval, richly gilded and filigreed in Moresque.","en":" The frame was oval, richly gilded and filigreed in Moresque.","es":" El marco era ovalado, ricamente dorado y trabajado en filigrana morisca."},{"original":" As a thing of art nothing could be more admirable than the painting itself.","en":" As a thing of art nothing could be more admirable than the painting itself.","es":" Como obra de arte, nada podía ser más admirable que la propia pintura."},{"original":" But it could have been neither the execution of the work, nor the immortal beauty of the countenance, which had so suddenly and so vehemently moved me.","en":" But it could have been neither the execution of the work, nor the immortal beauty of the countenance, which had so suddenly and so vehemently moved me.","es":" Pero no podían haber sido ni la ejecución de la obra ni la belleza inmortal del rostro las que me habían conmovido tan repentina y violentamente."},{"original":" Least of all, could it have been that my fancy, shaken from its half slumber, had mistaken the head for that of a living person.","en":" Least of all, could it have been that my fancy, shaken from its half slumber, had mistaken the head for that of a living person.","es":" Mucho menos podía ser que mi imaginación, arrancada de su duermevela, hubiera confundido aquella cabeza con la de una persona viva."},{"original":" I saw at once that the peculiarities of the design, of the vignetting, and of the frame, must have instantly dispelled such idea—must have prevented even its momentary entertainment.","en":" I saw at once that the peculiarities of the design, of the vignetting, and of the frame, must have instantly dispelled such idea—must have prevented even its momentary entertainment.","es":" Comprendí de inmediato que las peculiaridades del diseño, de la viñeta y del marco debían haber disipado instantáneamente tal idea, impidiendo incluso que la abrigara por un momento."},{"original":" Thinking earnestly upon these points, I remained, for an hour perhaps, half sitting, half reclining, with my vision riveted upon the portrait.","en":" Thinking earnestly upon these points, I remained, for an hour perhaps, half sitting, half reclining, with my vision riveted upon the portrait.","es":" Meditando intensamente sobre estos puntos, permanecí tal vez una hora, medio sentado, medio reclinado, con la mirada clavada en el retrato."},{"original":" At length, satisfied with the true secret of its effect, I fell back within the bed.","en":" At length, satisfied with the true secret of its effect, I fell back within the bed.","es":" Al fin, satisfecho de haber descubierto el verdadero secreto de su efecto, me dejé caer en la cama."},{"original":" I had found the spell of the picture in an absolute life-likeliness of expression, which, at first startling, finally confounded, subdued, and appalled me.","en":" I had found the spell of the picture in an absolute life-likeliness of expression, which, at first startling, finally confounded, subdued, and appalled me.","es":" Había encontrado el hechizo de la pintura en una absoluta semejanza con la vida en la expresión que, primero sorprendiéndome, terminó por confundirme, someterme y aterrarme."},{"original":" With deep and reverent awe I replaced the candelabrum in its former position.","en":" With deep and reverent awe I replaced the candelabrum in its former position.","es":" Con profundo y reverente sobrecogimiento devolví el candelabro a su posición anterior."},{"original":" The cause of my deep agitation being thus shut from view, I sought eagerly the volume which discussed the paintings and their histories.","en":" The cause of my deep agitation being thus shut from view, I sought eagerly the volume which discussed the paintings and their histories.","es":" Oculta así la causa de mi intensa agitación, busqué ansiosamente el volumen que trataba de las pinturas y sus historias."},{"original":" Turning to the number which designated the oval portrait, I there read the vague and quaint words which follow:","en":" Turning to the number which designated the oval portrait, I there read the vague and quaint words which follow:","es":" Al llegar al número que designaba el retrato oval, leí allí las palabras imprecisas y antiguas que siguen:"}],[{"original":"“She was a maiden of rarest beauty, and not more lovely than full of glee.","en":"“She was a maiden of rarest beauty, and not more lovely than full of glee.","es":"«Era una doncella de rarísima belleza, y tan llena de alegría como hermosa."},{"original":" And evil was the hour when she saw, and loved, and wedded the painter.","en":" And evil was the hour when she saw, and loved, and wedded the painter.","es":" Y funesta fue la hora en que vio, amó y desposó al pintor."},{"original":" He, passionate, studious, austere, and having already a bride in his Art; she a maiden of rarest beauty, and not more lovely than full of glee; all light and smiles, and frolicsome as the young fawn; loving and cherishing all things; hating only the Art which was her rival; dreading only the pallet and brushes and other untoward instruments which deprived her of the countenance of her lover.","en":" He, passionate, studious, austere, and having already a bride in his Art; she a maiden of rarest beauty, and not more lovely than full of glee; all light and smiles, and frolicsome as the young fawn; loving and cherishing all things; hating only the Art which was her rival; dreading only the pallet and brushes and other untoward instruments which deprived her of the countenance of her lover.","es":" Él, apasionado, estudioso, austero, y con una esposa ya en su Arte; ella, una doncella de rarísima belleza, y tan llena de alegría como hermosa, toda luz y sonrisas, juguetona como un cervatillo, que amaba y acariciaba todas las cosas, que odiaba únicamente al Arte, su rival, y temía solo la paleta, los pinceles y los demás instrumentos ingratos que la privaban de la presencia de su amado."},{"original":" It was thus a terrible thing for this lady to hear the painter speak of his desire to portray even his young bride.","en":" It was thus a terrible thing for this lady to hear the painter speak of his desire to portray even his young bride.","es":" Por eso fue terrible para aquella dama oír al pintor hablar de su deseo de retratar también a su joven esposa."},{"original":" But she was humble and obedient, and sat meekly for many weeks in the dark, high turret-chamber where the light dripped upon the pale canvas only from overhead.","en":" But she was humble and obedient, and sat meekly for many weeks in the dark, high turret-chamber where the light dripped upon the pale canvas only from overhead.","es":" Pero ella era humilde y obediente, y posó dócilmente durante muchas semanas en el oscuro y alto aposento de la torre, donde la luz caía sobre el pálido lienzo únicamente desde arriba."},{"original":" But he, the painter, took glory in his work, which went on from hour to hour, and from day to day.","en":" But he, the painter, took glory in his work, which went on from hour to hour, and from day to day.","es":" Pero él, el pintor, se enorgullecía de su obra, que avanzaba hora tras hora y día tras día."},{"original":" And he was a passionate, and wild, and moody man, who became lost in reveries; so that he would not see that the light which fell so ghastly in that lone turret withered the health and the spirits of his bride, who pined visibly to all but him.","en":" And he was a passionate, and wild, and moody man, who became lost in reveries; so that he would not see that the light which fell so ghastly in that lone turret withered the health and the spirits of his bride, who pined visibly to all but him.","es":" Y era un hombre apasionado, arrebatado y taciturno, que se perdía en sus ensueños; por eso no veía que la luz que caía tan lúgubremente en aquella torre solitaria marchitaba la salud y el ánimo de su esposa, que se consumía a ojos de todos salvo de él."},{"original":" Yet she smiled on and still on, uncomplainingly, because she saw that the painter (who had high renown) took a fervid and burning pleasure in his task, and wrought day and night to depict her who so loved him, yet who grew daily more dispirited and weak.","en":" Yet she smiled on and still on, uncomplainingly, because she saw that the painter (who had high renown) took a fervid and burning pleasure in his task, and wrought day and night to depict her who so loved him, yet who grew daily more dispirited and weak.","es":" Y aun así ella seguía sonriendo, sin quejarse, porque veía que el pintor —que gozaba de gran fama— encontraba un placer ferviente y ardoroso en su tarea y trabajaba día y noche para representar a quien tanto lo amaba y, sin embargo, se debilitaba y desanimaba cada día."},{"original":" And in sooth some who beheld the portrait spoke of its resemblance in low words, as of a mighty marvel, and a proof not less of the power of the painter than of his deep love for her whom he depicted so surpassingly well.","en":" And in sooth some who beheld the portrait spoke of its resemblance in low words, as of a mighty marvel, and a proof not less of the power of the painter than of his deep love for her whom he depicted so surpassingly well.","es":" Y, en verdad, algunos que veían el retrato hablaban en voz baja de su semejanza, como de una gran maravilla y una prueba tanto del poder del pintor como de su amor profundo por aquella a quien tan extraordinariamente bien retrataba."},{"original":" But at length, as the labor drew nearer to its conclusion, there were admitted none into the turret; for the painter had grown wild with the ardor of his work, and turned his eyes from canvas merely, even to regard the countenance of his wife.","en":" But at length, as the labor drew nearer to its conclusion, there were admitted none into the turret; for the painter had grown wild with the ardor of his work, and turned his eyes from canvas merely, even to regard the countenance of his wife.","es":" Pero finalmente, cuando el trabajo se acercaba a su término, ya no se admitió a nadie en la torre, pues el pintor se había vuelto frenético con el ardor de su obra y apenas apartaba los ojos del lienzo, ni siquiera para mirar el rostro de su esposa."},{"original":" And he would not see that the tints which he spread upon the canvas were drawn from the cheeks of her who sate beside him.","en":" And he would not see that the tints which he spread upon the canvas were drawn from the cheeks of her who sate beside him.","es":" Y no quería ver que los colores que extendía sobre el lienzo los extraía de las mejillas de la que estaba sentada a su lado."},{"original":" And when many weeks had passed, and but little remained to do, save one brush upon the mouth and one tint upon the eye, the spirit of the lady again flickered up as the flame within the socket of the lamp.","en":" And when many weeks had passed, and but little remained to do, save one brush upon the mouth and one tint upon the eye, the spirit of the lady again flickered up as the flame within the socket of the lamp.","es":" Y cuando habían pasado muchas semanas y quedaba poco por hacer, salvo una pincelada en la boca y un matiz en el ojo, el espíritu de la dama volvió a parpadear como la llama dentro de una lámpara."},{"original":" And then the brush was given, and then the tint was placed; and, for one moment, the painter stood entranced before the work which he had wrought; but in the next, while he yet gazed, he grew tremulous and very pallid, and aghast, and crying with a loud voice, ‘This is indeed Life itself!’ turned suddenly to regard his beloved:—She was dead!”","en":" And then the brush was given, and then the tint was placed; and, for one moment, the painter stood entranced before the work which he had wrought; but in the next, while he yet gazed, he grew tremulous and very pallid, and aghast, and crying with a loud voice, ‘This is indeed Life itself!’ turned suddenly to regard his beloved:—She was dead!”","es":" Y entonces se dio la pincelada, y entonces se puso el matiz; y durante un momento el pintor permaneció extasiado ante la obra que había realizado; pero al siguiente, mientras aún la contemplaba, tembló y se puso muy pálido, sobrecogido, y gritando con voz fuerte: “¡Esto es, en verdad, la Vida misma!”, se volvió de pronto para mirar a su amada: ¡estaba muerta!»"}]],"eligibility":"Born in a historically señora Mallard padecía del corazón, se tuvo mucho cuidado en comunicarle, con la mayor delicadeza posible, la noticia de la muerte de su marido."}],[{"original":"It was her sister Josephine who told her, in broken sentences; veiled hints that revealed in half concealing. Her husband's friend Richards was there, too, near her. It was he who had been in the newspaper office when intelligence of the railroad disaster was received, with Brently Mallard's name leading the list of \"killed.\" He had only taken the time to assure himself of its truth by a second telegram, and had hastened to forestall any less careful, less tender friend in bearing the sad message.","en":"It was her sister Josephine who told her, in broken sentences; veiled hints that revealed in half concealing. Her husband's friend Richards was there, too, near her. It was he who had been in the newspaper office when intelligence of the railroad disaster was received, with Brently Mallard's name leading the list of \"killed.\" He had only taken the time to assure himself of its truth by a second telegram, and had hastened to forestall any less careful, less tender friend in bearing the sad message.","es":"Fue su hermana Josephine quien se lo dijo, en frases entrecortadas; insinuaciones veladas que revelaban a medias lo que ocultaban. Richards, el amigo de su marido, también estaba allí, cerca de ella. Él había estado en la redacción del periódico cuando llegó la noticia del desastre ferroviario, con el nombre de Brently Mallard encabezando la lista de «muertos». Solo se había tomado el tiempo de comprobar la verdad con un segundo telegrama y se había apresurado a adelantarse a cualquier amigo menos cuidadoso, menos tierno, que pudiera llevar la triste noticia."}],[{"original":"She did not hear the story as many women have heard the same, with a paralyzed inability to accept its significance.","en":"She did not hear the story as many women have heard the same, with a paralyzed inability to accept its significance.","es":"Ella no oyó la historia como la han oído tantas mujeres, con una incapacidad paralizante de aceptar lo que significa."},{"original":" She wept at once, with sudden, wild abandonment, in her sister's arms.","en":" She wept at once, with sudden, wild abandonment, in her sister's arms.","es":" Lloró de inmediato, con un abandono súbito y desbordado, en brazos de su hermana."},{"original":" When the storm of grief had spent itself she went away to her room alone.","en":" When the storm of grief had spent itself she went away to her room alone.","es":" Cuando pasó la tormenta de dolor, se retiró sola a su habitación."},{"original":" She would have no one follow her.","en":" She would have no one follow her.","es":" No quiso que nadie la siguiera."}],[{"original":"There stood, facing the open window, a comfortable, roomy armchair.","en":"There stood, facing the open window, a comfortable, roomy armchair.","es":"Frente a la ventana abierta había un sillón cómodo y espacioso."},{"original":" Into this she sank, pressed down by a physical exhaustion that haunted her body and seemed to reach into her soul.","en":" Into this she sank, pressed down by a physical exhaustion that haunted her body and seemed to reach into her soul.","es":" Se dejó caer en él, oprimida por un agotamiento físico que perseguía su cuerpo y parecía penetrar hasta su alma."}],[{"original":"She could see in the open square before her house the tops of trees that were all aquiver with the new spring life.","en":"She could see in the open square before her house the tops of trees that were all aquiver with the new spring life.","es":"Podía ver en la plaza frente a su casa las copas de los árboles, todas estremecidas por la nueva vida de la primavera."},{"original":" The delicious breath of rain was in the air.","en":" The delicious breath of rain was in the air.","es":" El delicioso aliento de la lluvia estaba en el aire."},{"original":" In the street below a peddler was crying his wares.","en":" In the street below a peddler was crying his wares.","es":" Abajo, en la calle, un vendedor ambulante pregonaba su mercancía."},{"original":" The notes of a distant song which some one was singing reached her faintly, and countless sparrows were twittering in the eaves.","en":" The notes of a distant song which some one was singing reached her faintly, and countless sparrows were twittering in the eaves.","es":" Le llegaban débilmente las notas de una canción que alguien cantaba a lo lejos, y en los aleros gorjeaban innumerables gorriones."},{"original":" There were patches of blue sky showing here and there through the clouds that had met and piled one above the other in the west facing her window.","en":" There were patches of blue sky showing here and there through the clouds that had met and piled one above the other in the west facing her window.","es":" Aquí y allá se veían retazos de cielo azul entre las nubes que se habían reunido y amontonado unas sobre otras al oeste, frente a su ventana."}],[{"original":"She sat with her head thrown back upon the cushion of the chair, quite motionless, except when a sob came up into her throat and shook her, as a child who has cried itself to sleep continues to sob in its dreams.","en":"She sat with her head thrown back upon the cushion of the chair, quite motionless, except when a sob came up into her throat and shook her, as a child who has cried itself to sleep continues to sob in its dreams.","es":"Permanecía con la cabeza echada hacia atrás sobre el cojín del sillón, completamente inmóvil, salvo cuando un sollozo le subía a la garganta y la sacudía, como un niño que se ha dormido llorando sigue sollozando en sueños."}],[{"original":"She was young, with a fair, calm face, whose lines bespoke repression and even a certain strength.","en":"She was young, with a fair, calm face, whose lines bespoke repression and even a certain strength.","es":"Era joven, de rostro bello y sereno, cuyos rasgos expresaban represión e incluso cierta fuerza."},{"original":" But now there was a dull stare in her eyes, whose gaze was fixed away off yonder on one of those patches of blue sky.","en":" But now there was a dull stare in her eyes, whose gaze was fixed away off yonder on one of those patches of blue sky.","es":" Pero ahora había en sus ojos una mirada apagada, fija a lo lejos en uno de aquellos retazos de cielo azul."},{"original":" It was not a glance of reflection, but rather indicated a suspension of intelligent thought.","en":" It was not a glance of reflection, but rather indicated a suspension of intelligent thought.","es":" No era una mirada reflexiva, sino que indicaba más bien una suspensión del pensamiento consciente."}],[{"original":"There was something coming to her and she was waiting for it, fearfully.","en":"There was something coming to her and she was waiting for it, fearfully.","es":"Algo se acercaba a ella y lo esperaba con miedo."},{"original":" What was it?","en":" What was it?","es":" ¿Qué era?"},{"original":" She did not know; it was too subtle and elusive to name.","en":" She did not know; it was too subtle and elusive to name.","es":" No lo sabía; era demasiado sutil y esquivo para darle nombre."},{"original":" But she felt it, creeping out of the sky, reaching toward her through the sounds, the scents, the color that filled the air.","en":" But she felt it, creeping out of the sky, reaching toward her through the sounds, the scents, the color that filled the air.","es":" Pero lo sentía, deslizándose desde el cielo, tendiéndose hacia ella a través de los sonidos, los aromas y los colores que llenaban el aire."}],[{"original":"Now her bosom rose and fell tumultuously.","en":"Now her bosom rose and fell tumultuously.","es":"Ahora su pecho subía y bajaba tumultuosamente."},{"original":" She was beginning to recognize this thing that was approaching to possess her, and she was striving to beat it back with her will — as powerless as her two white slender hands would have been.","en":" She was beginning to recognize this thing that was approaching to possess her, and she was striving to beat it back with her will — as powerless as her two white slender hands would have been.","es":" Empezaba a reconocer aquello que se acercaba a poseerla y procuraba rechazarlo con su voluntad, tan impotente como lo habrían sido sus dos manos blancas y delgadas."},{"original":" When she abandoned herself a little whispered word escaped her slightly parted lips.","en":" When she abandoned herself a little whispered word escaped her slightly parted lips.","es":" Cuando se abandonó, una palabra susurrada escapó de sus labios ligeramente entreabiertos."},{"original":" She said it over and over under her breath: \"free, free, free!\" The vacant stare and the look of terror that had followed it went from her eyes.","en":" She said it over and over under her breath: \"free, free, free!\" The vacant stare and the look of terror that had followed it went from her eyes.","es":" La repitió una y otra vez en voz baja: «¡Libre, libre, libre!» La mirada vacía y la expresión de terror que la había seguido desaparecieron de sus ojos."},{"original":" They stayed keen and bright.","en":" They stayed keen and bright.","es":" Permanecieron vivos y brillantes."},{"original":" Her pulses beat fast, and the coursing blood warmed and relaxed every inch of her body.","en":" Her pulses beat fast, and the coursing blood warmed and relaxed every inch of her body.","es":" Le latía rápido el pulso, y la sangre que corría calentaba y relajaba cada centímetro de su cuerpo."},{"original":" She did not stop to ask if it were or were not a monstrous joy that held her.","en":" She did not stop to ask if it were or were not a monstrous joy that held her.","es":" No se detuvo a preguntarse si era o no una alegría monstruosa lo que la dominaba."},{"original":" A clear and exalted perception enabled her to dismiss the suggestion as trivial.","en":" A clear and exalted perception enabled her to dismiss the suggestion as trivial.","es":" Una percepción clara y exaltada le permitió descartar aquella idea como algo trivial."}],[{"original":"She knew that she would weep again when she saw the kind, tender hands folded in death; the face that had never looked save with love upon her, fixed and gray and dead.","en":"She knew that she would weep again when she saw the kind, tender hands folded in death; the face that had never looked save with love upon her, fixed and gray and dead.","es":"Sabía que volvería a llorar cuando viera las manos bondadosas y tiernas cruzadas en la muerte; el rostro que nunca la había mirado sino con amor, inmóvil, gris y muerto."},{"original":" But she saw beyond that bitter moment a long procession of years to come that would belong to her absolutely.","en":" But she saw beyond that completo."},{"original":" And she opened and spread her arms out to them in welcome.","en":" And she opened and spread her arms out to them in welcome.","es":" Y abrió y extendió los brazos para darles la bienvenida."},{"original":" There would be no one to live for her during those coming years; she would live for herself.","en":" There would be no one to live for her during those coming persistence with which men and women believe they have a right to impose a private will upon a fellow-creature.","en":" There would be no powerful will bending hers in that blind persistence with which men and women believe they have a right to impose a private will upon a fellow-creature.","es":" No habría una voluntad poderosa doblegando la suya con esa persistencia ciega con que hombres y una intención cruel no hacían que el acto le pareciera menos criminal en aquel breve momento de lucidez."}],[{"original":"And yet she had loved him — sometimes.","en":"And yet she had loved him — sometimes.","es":"Y, sin embargo, lo había amado, a veces."},{"original":" Often she had not.","en":" Often she had not.","es":" Muchas veces no."},{"original":" What did it matter!","en":" What did podía contar el amor, aquel misterio sin resolver, frente a esta conciencia de su propia autonomía que de pronto reconocía como el impulso más fuerte de su ser!"}],[{"original":"\"Free!","en":"\"Free!","es":"«¡Libre!"},{"original":" Body and soul free!\" she kept whispering.","en":" Body and soul free!\" she kept whispering.","es":" ¡Libre en cuerpo y make yourself ill.","es":" Te lo ruego, abre la puerta: vas a enfermar."},{"original":" What are you doing, Louise?","en":" What are you doing, Louise?","es":" ¿Qué estás haciendo, Spring days, and summer days, and all sorts of days that would be her own. She breathed a quick prayer that life might be long. It was only yesterday she had thought with a shudder that life might be long.","en":"\"Go away. I am not making myself ill.\" No; she was drinking in a very elixir of life through that open window. Her fancy was running riot along those days ahead of her. Spring days, and summer days, and all sorts of days that would be her own. She breathed a quick prayer that life might be long. It was only yesterday she had thought with a shudder that life might be long.","es":"«Vete. No voy a enfermar». No; estaba bebiendo un verdadero elixir de vida a través de aquella ventana abierta. Apenas ayer había pensado con un escalofrío que la vida podía ser larga."}],[{"original":"She arose at length and opened the door to her sister's importunities.","en":"She arose at length and opened the door to her sister's importunities.","es":"Por fin se levantó y abrió la puerta ante la insistencia de su hermana."},{"original":" There was a feverish triumph in her eyes, and she carried herself unwittingly like a goddess of Victory.","en":" There was a feverish triumph in her eyes, and she carried herself unwittingly like a goddess of Victory.","es":" Había un triunfo febril en sus ojos, y caminaba, sin saberlo, como una diosa de la Victoria."},{"original":" She clasped her sister's waist, and together they descended the stairs.","en":" She clasped her sister's waist, and together they descended the stairs.","es":" Rodeó con el brazo la cintura de su hermana y juntas bajaron la escalera."},{"original":" Richards stood waiting for them at the bottom.","en":" Richards stood waiting for them at the bottom.","es":" Richards las esperaba abajo."}],[{"original":"Someone was opening the front door with a latchkey.","en":"Someone was opening the front door with a latchkey.","es":"Alguien estaba abriendo la puerta de entrada con una llave."},{"original":" It was Brently Mallard who entered, a little travel-stained, composedly carrying his grip-sack and umbrella.","en":" It was Brently Mallard who entered, a little travel-stained, composedly carrying his grip-sack and umbrella.","es":" Entró Brently Mallard, algo cubierto del polvo del viaje, llevando tranquilamente su bolso y su paraguas."},{"original":" He had been far from the scene of the accident, and did not even know there had been one.","en":" He had been far from the scene of the accident, and did not even know there had been one.","es":" Había estado lejos del lugar del accidente y ni siquiera sabía que hubiera ocurrido uno."},{"original":" He stood amazed at Josephine's piercing cry; figure, silent for the past hour.","es":" Lo quería mucho, sin embargo, a veces con un ligero estremecimiento cuando volviendo de noche juntos por la calle, echaba una furtiva mirada a la alta palace.","es":" La blancura del patio silencioso—frisos, columnas y estatuas de mármol—producía una otoñal impresión de palacio encantado."},{"original":" Dentro, el brillo glacial del estuco, sin el más leve rasguño en las altas paredes, afirmaba aquella sensación de desapacible frío.","en":" Inside, the icy shine of the stucco, without the slightest scratch on the high walls, reinforced that feeling of disagreeable cold.","es":" Dentro, el brillo glacial del estuco, sin el más leve rasguño en las altas paredes, afirmaba aquella sensación de desapacible frío."},{"original":" Al cruzar de throughout the house, as though long abandonment had made its resonance more sensitive.","es":" Al cruzar de una pieza a otra, los pasos hallaban eco en toda la casa, como si un largo abandono hubiera sensibilizado su resonancia."}],[{"original":"En ese extraño nido de amor, Alicia pasó todo el otoño.","en":"In that strange love nest Alicia spent the whole autumn.","es":"En ese extraño nido de amor, Alicia pasó todo el otoño."},{"original":" No obstante, había concluído por echar un velo sobre sus antiguos sueños, y aún vivía dormida en la casa hostil, sin querer pensar en nada hasta que home.","es":" No obstante, había concluído por echar un velo sobre sus antiguos sueños, y aún vivía dormida en la casa hostil, sin querer pensar en nada hasta que llegaba su around his neck.","es":" De pronto Jordán, con honda ternura, le pasó la mano por la cabeza, y Alicia rompió en seguida en sollozos, echándole los brazos al cuello."},{"original":" Lloró largamente fueron retardándose, y aún quedó largo rato escondida en su cuello, sin moverse ni decir una palabra."}],[{"original":"Fué ese el último día que Alicia estuvo levantada.","en":"That was the last day pero el machete cayó de plano, dislocándole las vértebras."}],[{"original":"El hombre se bajó hasta la mordedura, quitó las gotitas de sangre, y durante un instante contempló.","en":"The man bent down to the bite, wiped away the little drops of blood and looked for a moment.","es":"El hombre se bajó hasta la mordedura, quitó las gotitas de sangre, y durante un instante contempló."},{"original":" Un dolor agudo nacía de los dos puntitos violeta, y comenzaba a invadir todo el pie.","en":" A sharp pain rose from the two tiny purple points and began invading the whole foot.","es":" Un dolor agudo nacía de los dos puntitos violeta, y comenzaba a invadir todo el pie."},{"original":" Apresuradamente se ligó el tobillo con su pañuelo y siguió por la picada hacia su rancho.","en":" Hastily he bound his ankle with his handkerchief and continued along the trail toward his hut.","es":" Apresuradamente se ligó el tobillo con su pañuelo y siguió por la picada hacia su rancho."}],[{"original":"El dolor en el pie aumentaba, con sensación de tirante abultamiento, y de pronto el hombre sintió dos o tres fulgurantes puntadas que como relámpagos habían irradiado desde la herida hasta la mitad de la pantorrilla.","en":"The pain in his foot increased, with a feeling of tight swelling, and suddenly he felt two or three dazzling stabs that radiated like lightning from the wound halfway up his calf.","es":"El dolor en el pie aumentaba, con sensación de tirante abultamiento, y de pronto el hombre sintió dos o tres fulgurantes puntadas que como relámpagos habían irradiado desde la herida hasta la mitad de la pantorrilla."},{"original":" Movía la pierna con dificultad;
